HPCL-IF-0013.title: Jute Batching Oil
HPCL-IF-0013.subTitle: Wash Oil
HPCL-IF-0013.description: JBO is a mineral oil fraction, generally mixed with water and emulsifiers. This is traditionally mineral based modern ecofriendly versions.  JBs applied to raw jute fibers to soften them and give cohesion during processing.
HPCL-IF-0013.appData: JBO softens raw jute fibers for easier processing by adding flexibility and cohesion reducig breakage. It also used in steel plant to recover aromatics from oven gas.

HPCL-IF-0008.title: VLSFO (Very Low Sulfur Fuel Oil) RMG380
HPCL-IF-0008.subTitle: MARINE FUEL
HPCL-IF-0008.description: VLSFO is a type of marine fuel that complies with the International Maritime Organization (IMO) – Marine Oil Pollution Control (MARPOL) regulations to reduce sulphur emissions from ships. It is generally blended from different refinery streams to achieve low sulfur levels while maintaining suitable viscosity and energy content for ship engines. VLSFO is a cleaner marine fuel with very low sulfur content (0.5% by wt. max./as per statutory norms) and prescribed limit of element content in fuel (Na, V, Al, Si, Ca, Zn, P).
HPCL-IF-0008.appData: VLSFO is primarily used as a marine fuel in ships to comply with IMO regulations. VLSFO is used in various types of vessels, including container ships, bulk carriers, etc.

HPCL-IF-0010.title: Paving Bitumen (VG10)
HPCL-IF-0010.subTitle: ROAD CONSTRUCTION MATERIAL
HPCL-IF-0010.description: Bitumen is obtained as the last residue in fractional distillation of crude petroleum. It is defined as a viscous liquid, or a solid, consisting essentially of complex mixture of hydrocarbons including high-molecular-weight compounds, such as asphaltenes, and lighter fractions, such as aromatics and saturates. It is substantially non-volatile and softens gradually when heated. It is black or brown in colour & possesses waterproofing and adhesive properties.
HPCL-IF-0010.appData: Paving bitumen is extensively used in the construction of roads, highways and airport tarmac.

HPCL-IF-0029.title: Crumb Rubber Modified Bitumen (CRMB60)
HPCL-IF-0029.subTitle: Bitumen
HPCL-IF-0029.description: Crumb Rubber Modified Bitumen (CRMB) is a high-performance asphalt binder created by blending bitumen with crumb rubber derived from recycled tires along with special additives. It enhances road durability by improving flexibility, reducing cracking and resisting deformation under heavy traffic and extreme temperatures.

specifications.property: Thin Film Oven Test – Loss in Mass

HPCL-IF-0029.appData: CRMB is extensively used in the construction of roads, highways and airport tarmac where improved durability, resistance to rutting and enhanced flexibility are required.

HPCL-IF-0011.appData: Paving bitumen is extensively used in the construction of roads, highways and airport tarmac.

HPCL-IF-0026.title: HSD
HPCL-IF-0026.subTitle: Automotive fuel
HPCL-IF-0026.description: High Speed Diesel (HSD) is a middle distillate petroleum fuel used in compression ignition (CI) engines. It is the largest consumed petroleum product in India. HSD is refined from crude oil through atmospheric distillation followed by hydrotreating for sulfur removal and blending for performance compliance. In India, HSD conforms to Bharat Stage VI (BS-VI) emission norms.
HPCL-IF-0026.appData: Primarily used as an automotive fuel for passenger vehicles, heavy commercial vehicles such as trucks and buses, and rail locomotives. It is also widely used in construction and mining equipment, agricultural tractors, diesel generators and marine engines.

It enhances road durability by improving flexibility, reducing cracking and resisting deformation under heavy traffic and extreme temperature conditions.

HPCL-IF-0025.title: MS
HPCL-IF-0025.subTitle: Automotive fuel
HPCL-IF-0025.description: Motor Spirit (MS) is a light petroleum distillate used in spark-ignition internal combustion engines. It is produced through atmospheric distillation, catalytic reforming, isomerization and blending of various refinery streams. In India, Motor Spirit conforms to Bharat Stage VI (BS-VI) emission norms.
HPCL-IF-0025.appData: Primarily used as an automotive fuel for passenger vehicles including cars, motorcycles and scooters. It is also used in small generators, agricultural light machinery and recreational vehicles.

HPCL-IF-0027.title: ISKO
HPCL-IF-0027.subTitle: Heating & cleaning
HPCL-IF-0027.description: Superior Kerosene Oil (SKO) is a middle distillate petroleum fraction heavier than gasoline but lighter than diesel. It is produced during atmospheric distillation of crude oil. Historically used as a domestic fuel, its usage has declined with the introduction of cleaner fuel alternatives.
HPCL-IF-0027.appData: Traditionally used for domestic lighting in kerosene lamps and cooking in kerosene stoves, though usage has declined. It is also used in industrial burners, solvent applications, and as fuel for small boat engines.

HPCL-IF-0024.title: Propylene
HPCL-IF-0024.subTitle: Feedstock
HPCL-IF-0024.description: Propylene is a light, colorless hydrocarbon and an unsaturated alkene. It is produced during crude oil refining and steam cracking of hydrocarbons.
HPCL-IF-0024.appData: Propylene is widely used as a chemical feedstock for the production of polypropylene (PP) plastics, oxo alcohols used in plasticizers and solvents, acrylonitrile, propylene oxide and other petrochemical derivatives. It is also used as an octane enhancing component in gasoline blending.

HPCL-IF-0012.title: Paving Bitumen (VG40)
HPCL-IF-0012.subTitle: ROAD CONSTRUCTION MATERIAL
HPCL-IF-0012.description: Bitumen is obtained as the last residue in fractional distillation of crude petroleum. It is defined as a viscous liquid, or a solid, consisting essentially of complex mixture of hydrocarbons including high-molecular-weight compounds, such as asphaltenes, and lighter fractions, such as aromatics and saturates. It is substantially non-volatile and softens gradually when heated. It is black or brown in colour & possesses waterproofing and adhesive properties.
HPCL-IF-0012.appData: Paving bitumen is extensively used in the construction of roads, highways and airport tarmac.

HPCL-IF-0028.title: CBFS
HPCL-IF-0028.subTitle: Feedstock
HPCL-IF-0028.description: Carbon Black Feedstock (CBFS) is a heavy aromatic hydrocarbon oil used as the primary raw material for manufacturing carbon black. It is rich in aromatic hydrocarbons, which are essential for efficient carbon black formation in furnace-type reactors.
HPCL-IF-0028.appData: CBFS is used as a process feedstock for producing tyre-grade carbon black, rubber-grade carbon black, pigment-grade carbon black and specialty carbon black used in inks, coatings and plastics.

HPCL-IF-0018.title: FO 380
HPCL-IF-0018.subTitle: Marine Fuel
HPCL-IF-0018.description: FO 380 is a high-viscosity residual marine fuel primarily used in large ocean-going vessels equipped with slow-speed and medium-speed diesel engines. Traditionally supplied as High Sulfur Fuel Oil (HSFO) (up to 3.5% sulfur), its usage today is largely restricted to vessels fitted with exhaust gas cleaning systems (scrubbers) in order to comply with IMO 2020 sulfur regulations.
HPCL-IF-0018.appData: Fuel used in ocean-going vessels fitted with exhaust gas cleaning systems (scrubbers) to comply with IMO 2020 sulfur regulations.

HPCL-IF-0020.title: Paving Bitumen (VG 40 Super)
HPCL-IF-0020.subTitle: Industrial Construction
HPCL-IF-0020.description: Bitumen is obtained as the last residue in fractional distillation of crude petroleum. It is defined as a viscous liquid or solid consisting essentially of a complex mixture of hydrocarbons including high molecular weight compounds such as asphaltenes and lighter fractions such as aromatics and saturates. It is substantially non-volatile and softens gradually when heated. It is black or brown in colour and possesses waterproofing and adhesive properties.
HPCL-IF-0020.appData: Paving bitumen is extensively used in the construction of roads, highways and airport tarmac.

HPCL-IF-0007.title: HFHSD (High Flash High Speed Diesel - Distillate Marine Fuel )
HPCL-IF-0007.subTitle: MARINE FUEL
HPCL-IF-0007.description: High Flash High Speed Diesel (HFHSD) is a special grade of diesel fuel with flash point (Min. 66°C) significantly higher than that of HSD (Min. 35°C). It consists of hydrocarbons with carbon numbers predominantly in the range of C9 to C28, with a boiling range of approximately 150°C to 400°C. It is produced by refining middle-distillate fractions to meet stringent safety and performance specifications IS 16731(ISO 8217).

specifications.property: Carbon residue – Micro method on the 10 % volume distillation residue

specifications.value: corrected wear scar diameter (WSD) at 60 °C, μm, Max 520

HPCL-IF-0007.appData: HFHSD is mainly manufactured for non-automotive applications. It is mainly applicable for marine use by Indian Navy, Merchant Ships, fishing vessels etc. where a high flash point diesel is required.

HPCL-IF-0031.title: BS VI B7 HSD
HPCL-IF-0031.subTitle: nan
HPCL-IF-0031.description: BS-VI B7 HSD is a biodiesel-blended variant of BS-VI High Speed Diesel, produced by blending regular BS-VI HSD with 7% biodiesel. It meets the same BS-VI performance parameters as standard HSD while reducing net carbon emissions through the renewable biodiesel component. It is supplied to customers as a part of sustainability initiatives.

specifications.property: Base fuel meets BS-VI HSD specification
Copper Strip Corrosion for 3 h at 50°C

HPCL-IF-0031.appData: Used as an automotive and industrial fuel for compression-ignition engines and power generation equipment (e.g. diesel gensets), functionally identical to standard BS-VI HSD, with the added benefit of a renewable biodiesel component supporting decarbonisation/sustainability goals.

HPCL-IF-0032.title: HP INDUSTRIAL DIESEL OIL (LDO)
HPCL-IF-0032.subTitle: Black Oils
HPCL-IF-0032.description: HP Industrial Diesel Oil (LDO), is a middle distillate fuel. It is a non-automotive diesel fuel used in medium and slow-speed compression ignition (CI) engines running below 750 RPM and also in pwoer plants. LDO is classified as a 'Class C' petroleum product based on its flash point.
HPCL-IF-0032.appData: Used as fuel in Power generation plants, stationary compression-ignition engines operating below 750 RPM, such as pumping sets and DG sets. Also used for firing boilers and in hot-mix plants for road construction.

HPCL-IF-0033.title: LSHS PREMIUM
HPCL-IF-0033.subTitle: Black Oils
HPCL-IF-0033.description: Low Sulphur Heavy Stock (LSHS) Premium is a residual fuel oil produced from processing of indigenous crude oils. It is obtained in lieu of Furnace Oil and primarily differs from FO in its sulphur content (max 1% vs up to 4.5% for FO), making it a cleaner substitute fuel where low-sulphur norms apply.
HPCL-IF-0033.appData: Used as a low-sulphur substitute for Furnace Oil in industrial boilers and furnaces, particularly in regions/states where high-sulphur FO use is restricted or banned by pollution control authorities.

HPCL-IF-0034.title: FO
HPCL-IF-0034.subTitle: Black Oils
HPCL-IF-0034.description: Furnace Oil (FO) - also known as Bunker Fuel, Fuel Oil, Heavy Fuel Oil (HFO) or Intermediate Fuel Oil (IFO) - is a dark, viscous residual fuel obtained as a heavy distillate from crude oil refining. It is supplied in LV, MV1, MV2 and HV viscosity grades.
HPCL-IF-0034.appData: Used for steam generation, industrial furnaces and power generation. Also used as a feedstock for fertiliser manufacturing.

HPCL-IF-0037.title: NAPHTHA
HPCL-IF-0037.subTitle: Specialty Products
HPCL-IF-0037.description: Naphtha is a light petroleum distillate fraction with hydrocarbons boiling between 30°C and 200°C, generally containing 5 to 12 carbon atoms per molecule. It is primarily processed through catalytic reforming, which converts naphtha into high-octane reformate used for gasoline blending and as feedstock for aromatic petrochemicals.

specifications.value: BIS IS 1448 (various parts) – Typical export-grade guaranteed specification

HPCL-IF-0037.appData: Used as feedstock for catalytic reforming to produce high-octane gasoline blending stock, and as a key petrochemical feedstock for steam cracking to produce olefins (ethylene, propylene) and aromatics (benzene, toluene, xylene) used in plastics manufacturing.

HPCL-IF-0038.title: HP SOLVENT 1425
HPCL-IF-0038.subTitle: Specialty Products
HPCL-IF-0038.description: HP Solvent 1425 is a Special Boiling Point (SBP) solvent - a fast-to-medium evaporating aliphatic hydrocarbon fluid consisting of paraffins and cycloparaffins in the C6-C10 range. It has a narrow boiling range, low aromatic content and a mild, sweet odour.

specifications.value: Clear and bright, free from un-dissolved water/foreign matter

HPCL-IF-0038.appData: Used for cleaning and degreasing to remove grease, oil, brake fluid and other contaminants from workshop floors, walls, vehicles and machinery; used in rubber compounding; and as a solvent in adhesives and sealants.

HPCL-IF-0039.title: HP MTO 2445
HPCL-IF-0039.subTitle: Specialty Products
HPCL-IF-0039.description: HP MTO 2445 is a colourless petroleum-derived Mineral Turpentine Oil (MTO), mainly comprising aliphatic hydrocarbons (C10 and above). It is chemically stable, non-corrosive, has medium evaporating characteristics, leaves no non-volatile residue on evaporation, and has a mild, sweet odour with low aromatic content.

specifications.value: Clear and bright, free from un-dissolved water/foreign matter

HPCL-IF-0039.appData: Used as a raw material and thinner in the paint industry, solvent for textile printing with pigment colours, dry-cleaning solvent, carrier for oil-soluble waxes and resins in polish manufacture, thinner for rust preventives, solvent for metal/machine degreasing and industrial cleaning, solvent in electrical insulating compounds and insecticidal formulations, and diluent for waterproofing/mothproofing/binding/sealing compounds.

HPCL-IF-0040.title: HP FOOD GRADE HEXANE
HPCL-IF-0040.subTitle: Specialty Products
HPCL-IF-0040.description: HP Food Grade Hexane is a colourless, volatile, flammable liquid with a gasoline-like odour and a narrow boiling range of 63-70°C. It leaves no non-volatile residue on evaporation and has a low aromatic content, making it suitable for food-grade solvent extraction applications.

specifications.value: Clear and bright, free from un-dissolved water/foreign matter

HPCL-IF-0040.appData: Used as a solvent for extraction of vegetable oils (groundnut, mustard, cottonseed, soybean, rapeseed, rice bran) for edible and soap-making purposes, extraction of essential oils from flowers, preparation of rubber adhesives and sealing compounds, and as a carrier in pharmaceutical and polymer industries.

HPCL-IF-0041.title: JBO
HPCL-IF-0041.subTitle: Specialty Products
HPCL-IF-0041.description: Jute Batching Oil (JBO) is a specially blended mineral oil used as a softening, lubricating and antistatic/emulsifying agent in the jute textile industry, applied to jute fibres prior to spinning to improve pliability and reduce breakage during processing.
HPCL-IF-0041.appData: Applied as a softening, lubricating and antistatic/emulsifying agent on jute fibres before spinning, to improve fibre pliability and reduce breakage during batching and spinning.

HPCL-IF-0042.title: SULPHUR
HPCL-IF-0042.subTitle: Specialty Products
HPCL-IF-0042.description: Sulphur is a by-product recovered from the desulphurisation units at HPCL's refineries (Mumbai and Visakh). It is produced at approximately 140°C with about 99.9% purity, solidifies at normal ambient temperature.
HPCL-IF-0042.appData: Used as a raw material for manufacturing sulphuric acid, fertilisers, fungicides and pesticides, batteries, pharmaceutical products, and for rubber vulcanisation and paint formulation.
